sections.section_content:
The final and mandatory step, after all the above configurations, is to trigger the display.
TheLTDC has two working mode:
• Continuous mode: the LTDC continuously sends frames to the display.
• Single-frame mode: the LTDC sends a single frame after a software-based trigger
(generated by a software access to a register)
Parameters in LTDC_GCR
• LTDCEN: general LTDC activation
• SFEN: moves from the continuous to the single-frame mode.
• SFSWTR: software trigger, when in single-frame mode
